mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ent_enterprise WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO collector_source_cursor(identity_hash, enterprise_id) VALUES (#{identity}, #{enterpriseId})
mapper.select: SELECT current_record_id, current_version, current_fingerprint, source_updated_at FROM collector_source_cursor WHERE identity_hash = #{identity} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE collector_record SET identity_hash = #{identity}, record_version = 1, change_type = 'NEW' WHERE id = #{id} AND identity_hash IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collector_record (source, external_id, record_type, enterprise_id, title, summary, raw_payload, content_hash, published_at, validity_status, identity_hash, record_version, change_type) VALUES (#{source}, #{externalId}, #{recordType}, #{enterpriseId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{rawPayload}, #{contentHash}, #{publishedAt}, #{validityStatus}, #{identity}, #{version}, #{changeType})
mapper.update: UPDATE collector_record SET validity_status = 'SUPERSEDED' WHERE id = #{id} AND validity_status = 'VALID'
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.title, r.summary, r.raw_payload, r.published_at, r.identity_hash, s.source_url, s.observed_at, s.strength, s.confidence, s.expires_at FROM collector_record r LEFT JOIN ent_company_signal s ON s.id = (SELECT MIN(x.id) FROM ent_company_signal x WHERE x.source_record_id = r.id AND x.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id) WHERE r.content_hash = #{contentHash}
SELECT id, source, record_type, enterprise_id, title, summary FROM collector_record WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ent_company_signal (enterprise_id, signal_type, title, detail, source_name, source_url, observed_at, strength, source_record_id, confidence, expires_at) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{signalType}, #{title}, #{detail}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{observedAt}, #{strength}, #{sourceRecordId}, #{confidence}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM collector_record r WHERE r.validity_status = 'VALID' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ent_company_signal s WHERE s.source_record_id = r.id AND s.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND s.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND s.expires_at < NOW()) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE collector_record SET validity_status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE id = #{id} AND validity_status = 'VALID'
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.event_type, o.source_record_id, r.enterprise_id, r.source, r.record_type, r.published_at, r.fetched_at, r.validity_status, r.record_version, r.change_type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.raw_payload, '$.demo'))), 'false') NOT IN ('false', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_demo FROM collector_event_outbox o JOIN collector_record r ON r.id = o.source_record_id WHERE ((o.status = 'PENDING' AND o.next_attempt_at <= NOW()) OR (o.status = 'LEASED' AND o.lease_until < NOW())) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE collector_event_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = NOW(), lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'LEASED' AND lease_token = #{token} AND lease_until >= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, uscc FROM ent_enterprise WHERE (#{uscc} IS NOT NULL AND #{uscc} != '' AND uscc = #{uscc}) OR ((#{uscc} IS NULL OR #{uscc} = '') AND #{name} IS NOT NULL AND #{name} != '' AND name = #{name}) ORDER BY id LIMIT 2

SELECT source, record_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count, MAX(fetched_at) AS last_fetched_at, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_payload, '$.demo'))), 'false') NOT IN ('false', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS demo_count, SUM(CASE WHEN fetched_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fetched_24h FROM collector_record GROUP BY source, record_type ORDER BY source, record_type

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collector_record) AS record_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collector_record WHERE COALESCE(LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_payload, '$.demo'))), 'false') NOT IN ('false', '0')) AS demo_record_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ent_company_signal) AS signal_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collector_record WHERE fetched_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS fetched_24h, (SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM collector_record) AS last_fetched_at

where.if: AND (r.title LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR r.summary LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR e.name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collector_record r JOIN ent_enterprise e ON e.id = r.enterprise_id

SELECT r.id, r.source, r.record_type, r.enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, r.title, r.summary, r.published_at, r.fetched_at, r.record_version, r.change_type, CASE WHEN r.validity_status = 'VALID' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ent_company_signal s WHERE s.source_record_id = r.id AND s.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND s.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND s.expires_at < NOW()) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE r.validity_status END AS validity_status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.raw_payload, '$.demo'))), 'false') NOT IN ('false', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_demo FROM collector_record r JOIN ent_enterprise e ON e.id = r.enterprise_id
ORDER BY r.fetched_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

where.if: AND (s.title LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR s.detail LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR e.name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ent_company_signal s JOIN ent_enterprise e ON e.id = s.enterprise_id

SELECT s.id, s.enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, s.signal_type, s.title, s.detail, s.source_name, s.source_url, s.observed_at, s.expires_at, s.strength, s.confidence, s.created_at, r.record_version, r.change_type, CASE WHEN r.validity_status = 'VALID' AND s.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND s.expires_at < NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE r.validity_status END AS validity_status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.raw_payload, '$.demo'))), 'false') NOT IN ('false', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_demo FROM ent_company_signal s JOIN ent_enterprise e ON e.id = s.enterprise_id LEFT JOIN collector_record r ON r.id = s.source_record_id AND r.enterprise_id = s.enterprise_id
ORDER BY s.observed_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
